import events from './events.json' with {type:'json'};
import crypto from 'node:crypto';

const SECRET = 'pilot-event-page-secret';
const MIN_PAGE = 1;
const MAX_PAGE = 3;
const DEFAULT_PAGE = 2;

function sign(payload) {
  return crypto.createHmac('sha256', SECRET).update(payload).digest('hex').slice(0, 16);
}

function encodeCursor(offset) {
  const payload = String(offset);
  const sig = sign(payload);
  return Buffer.from(`${payload}.${sig}`, 'utf8').toString('base64url');
}

function decodeCursor(cursor) {
  let decoded;
  try {
    decoded = Buffer.from(cursor, 'base64url').toString('utf8');
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Unknown cursor');
  }
  const idx = decoded.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Unknown cursor');
  const payload = decoded.slice(0, idx);
  const sig = decoded.slice(idx + 1);
  if (!payload || !sig) throw new Error('Unknown cursor');
  if (sign(payload) !== sig) throw new Error('Unknown cursor');
  const offset = Number(payload);
  if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset >= events.length) {
    throw new Error('Unknown cursor');
  }
  return offset;
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'events_list',
    description: 'List events with pagination',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        cursor: { type: 'string', description: 'Opaque pagination cursor' },
        page_size: { type: 'integer', minimum: MIN_PAGE, maximum: MAX_PAGE, default: DEFAULT_PAGE, description: 'Number of events per page (1-3, default 2)' }
      },
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }];
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'events_list') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  // validate extra fields
  const allowed = new Set(['cursor', 'page_size']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown argument: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  let page_size = DEFAULT_PAGE;
  if (args.page_size !== undefined) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(args.page_size) || args.page_size < MIN_PAGE || args.page_size > MAX_PAGE) {
      throw new Error(`page_size must be an integer between ${MIN_PAGE} and ${MAX_PAGE}`);
    }
    page_size = args.page_size;
  }
  let offset = 0;
  if (args.cursor !== undefined) {
    if (typeof args.cursor !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('cursor must be a string');
    }
    offset = decodeCursor(args.cursor);
  }
  const slice = events.slice(offset, offset + page_size);
  const result = { events: slice };
  if (offset + page_size < events.length) {
    result.next_cursor = encodeCursor(offset + page_size);
  }
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(result) }] };
}
